$comment: How a test project is split across CI jobs (#2054); read by .github/scripts/test-shard-filter.ps1. Each project's 'shards' lists the class-name prefixes of every shard but the last; the last shard is everything the others did not take, so a new class always runs somewhere. A prefix matches by contains on FullyQualifiedName, and a shard leaves out what an earlier shard took, so the shards never overlap. The workflow's matrix states the shard count beside this file, and the script refuses a count that disagrees with it. Balanced on the Windows per-class times of run 42804689190 (tools/ci-test-timings.py), where the unit suite's Dataset+Viewer+Orrery+Stretch shard summed 1001 s and the functional suite's last shard 1083 s; rebalance from that table on the PR that changes it.
